messages.text:
Happy to. Quick facts first: the BS-4 is 22 TH/s at about 300 W, $599.99, water cooled, roughly 50 dB. It's not buyable yet, the drop is October 4.

On the numbers, at a generic US rate of $0.17/kWh a 30 TH/s B30 stacks about 43,000 sats a month (~$36) against ~$50 of power, so power price decides everything. The B.4's 300 W makes it the cheapest to run of the three.

Where are you mining, and do you know your rate per kWh? I'll rerun it properly.

I don't have a Nigerian tariff on file, so here's Lagos at $0.14/kWh, roughly Band A. Tell me your real rate and I'll rerun.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 405 W: about 43,000 sats a month, worth $36 today, against $41 of power. Break-even BTC price $96,006.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W: about 57,400 sats a month, worth $48, against $66 of power. Break-even $115,562.

Solo jackpot either way is 3.149 BTC, about 0.2% odds over a year.

Honestly, at Lagos rates the BS-4's 300 W is the sweeter spot. It drops October 4.
our still going to have the same THs uncertainty like on the BS-2 and 1

Straight answer: that's exactly what the delay is about. BitFortun is updating the firmware so the hashrate the unit shows matches what it's actually doing, after the terahash issue on the BS-1 and BS-2. That's why the BS-4 drop moved to mid-October, with no exact day yet. Correcting myself on the October 4 I gave you earlier, that date isn't confirmed.

I can't hold a unit for you, no one can, a drop goes to whoever checks out first. I can tell you the day it's announced. Want that?
i would appreciate that. but i also need a shipping rate for Lagos, Nigeria

Shipping to Lagos runs $40 flat, and it's DDP, so customs and duties are prepaid, nothing extra on delivery. That's a live quote on a B30-sized miner; the BS-4 is lighter, so $40 is the ceiling. The exact figure confirms at checkout on drop day.

The listed $599.99 is the unit price, shipping on top.

What's the best email for the drop date? I'll make sure you get it the day it's announced.
i cant get that from the website the last time i wanted to buy a unit

Fair, and worth sorting before the drop. On my side just now Lagos quoted fine, $40 DDP on a miner, so it should work today.

What did you hit last time, no shipping option at the address step, or the payment getting declined? Those are two different fixes and I'll get the right one done before the BS-4 opens.
Handed to the team · Needs to be added to the BS-4 drop-date notification and a checkout issue for Ni

Got it, Henry, I've got that address down for the BS-4 date, and I've put your checkout problem in front of the team so it's cleared before the drop. Stay in the chat and one of them can jump in here; if you step away, it comes to your email.

One thing that helps them: last time, was it that no shipping option showed at the address step, or did the payment itself fail?
many thanks. i recall i also sent them an email on that check out issue

Good, that helps, I've noted it so they can pull that thread up with your name on it rather than starting over.

Before you go, one thing: you've weighed the BS-2 and the BS-4 in this chat, what's tipping you toward the 22 TH/s one?
